task.title: Idempotency guard for the retry worker
task.requested_change: Make the retry worker reject duplicate job ids instead of re-executing them.
task.problem_statement: A replayed message runs the job body twice, writing the ledger twice.
acceptance_criteria: The retry worker must reject a duplicate job id and return the result already recorded for it.
The idempotency guard records each job id exactly once in the ledger.
A replayed request produces no second side effect and logs a skip.
